nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Uses the source get_report contract: omit reportId to create, supply reportId to poll, or supply a backend documentToken to download.

adProduct.description: Ad product required by a new report unless configuration supplies it.

configuration.description: Complete Amazon Ads reporting configuration; may replace reportTypeId/adProduct/groupBy/columns.

documentToken.description: Backend-issued token for downloading a completed report.

endDate.description: Inclusive report end date for a new report.

reportId.description: Existing report ID; when present the API polls that report.

reportTypeId.description: Report type required by a new report unless configuration supplies it.

startDate.description: Inclusive report start date for a new report.

name: nexscope_amazon_ads_reporting
title: Amazon Ads Reporting
